    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BytecodeEmitter
    Direct classfile emitter for IR (M2/M3); preferred over generated Java.
    ClassEmitter
    mJVM M2 — emit a .class for IR via generated Java + javac.
    CorpusCase
    One shared corpus case (same schema as pymumps/c3mumps conformance.json).
    CorpusRunner
    J0 corpus runner: load shared conformance.json and execute each case.
    CorpusScore
    Score a corpus prefix (default C01–C39) against LineEngine.
    Engine
    Direct-mode engine: evaluate one M line, return stdout text.
    ExprEngine
    Expression-only engine: evaluate M expr strings via ExprEval.
    ExprEval
    J1 expression evaluator: M values + ISO arithmetic, concat, compare, logic.
    ExprEval.Env
     
    Indy
    mJVM M3 — invokedynamic bootstrap for DO/$$/GOTO call sites.
    IndyLink
    mJVM M3 — functional interface used as an invokedynamic call-site shape.
    Ir
    Flat stack-ish IR for compiled M (mJVM M1).
    IrMachine
    Interpreter for Ir programs (parity path vs ClassEmitter).
    JobChild
    J10 child process for JOB — runs one M line then exits.
    LineEngine
    Direct-mode engine over LineInterp (J2 core commands).
    LineInterp
    J2 interpreter — command-aware parsing (IF/FOR eat their argument lists).
    MError
    M runtime error (ISO / RSM error channel).
    MFrontend
    mJVM M1 frontend — direct-mode M line(s) → Ir.
    Mjvm
    mJVM CLI (M7) — drop-in shaped like rsm (Reference Standard M).
    MjvmBench
    mJVM M8 benchmark harness (M8).
    MRuntime
    mJVM runtime (M2/M3) — executes Ir against a StoreApi.
    MRuntime.ExtrinsicHandler
     
    MRuntime.Resolver
    M3: CALL site — invoke a compiled routine via the resolver.
    MStore
    In-memory StoreApi (direct-mode default; no persistence).
    MStore.Node
     
    MValue
    M value: numeric or string (ISO); empty string is the default.
    PatternMatch
    M pattern match (ISO 7.1.4.1): classes, literals, counts, and groups n.(...) / n(alternative,...).
    SqlStore
    SQLite-backed StoreApi (WAL; tests use temp files).
    StoreApi
    Persistence SPI for M globals and locals (JvMumps / mJVM shared).
    StoreDb
    Shared SQLite helpers for SqlStore.
    StubEngine
    J0 placeholder engine: holds a symbol table and echoes trivial SET/WRITE.
